cards.title: AI Graveyard: Failed Projects and Missed Expectations
cards.body: From Apple's delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy super app launch, major AI initiatives have shuttered or underperformed. The graveyard reveals significant gaps between AI ambitions and execution.

cards.title: Asian Governments React to Jensen Huang Exit
cards.body: Governments are confirming chip supply commitments and monitoring impacts on local AI projects following Nvidia's leadership transition. Some are addressing ongoing investigations related to the departure.

cards.title: Huang Exit Threatens AI Startup Funding Pipeline
cards.body: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang's leadership. Founders and VCs now expect smaller funding rounds and lower valuations ahead.

cards.title: LangChain Hits $3B Valuation Milestone
cards.body: The AI agent startup now serves 7,000 customers using its model-agnostic LangSmith tool. The valuation reflects strong demand for enterprise agent management platforms.

cards.title: Banned Nvidia Chips Power China's Advanced AI
cards.body: Research reveals China's most powerful AI models were trained on export-banned Nvidia hardware. The discovery raises national security concerns in the US-China AI race.

cards.title: ChatGPT Wallet Enables AI Shopping Agents
cards.body: OpenAI's new ChatGPT Wallet allows AI agents to shop and checkout on users' behalf. The feature is rolling out to US Pro subscribers in limited release.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Scandal Timeline
cards.body: Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, with potential national security implications. The departure occurs during a critical US-China AI infrastructure race.

cards.title: ElevenLabs Launches New Meeting AI App
cards.body: ElevenAI combines meeting note-taking and dictation features for teams and enterprises. The platform targets the growing market for AI-powered meeting assistance.

cards.title: Israeli VCs See Nvidia Opportunity Amid Turmoil
cards.body: Israel's startup ecosystem views Huang's departure as a potential opening for Nvidia competitors. The transition raises concerns about Nvidia's continued dominance in AI hardware.

cards.title: Huang Doubted Successor's Readiness Reports
cards.body: Huang reportedly described his successor Kress as a 'deer in the headlights' during a summer meeting. The comment raises questions about leadership stability at Nvidia.

cards.title: Democrats Launch Second Nvidia Investigation
cards.body: Congressional Democrats are investigating Nvidia's China sales and alleged dealings with Trump related to Huang's departure. The probe follows revelations of Huang's alleged spy affair.

cards.title: Muse AI Now Places US Business Calls
cards.body: Muse's AI can now make outbound calls to US businesses with a paid subscription model. The capability expands AI agent applications in customer outreach.

cards.title: Nebius Plans $40B AI Infrastructure Expansion
cards.body: The neocloud company aims to fund massive AI infrastructure growth through customer prepayments and loans. Microsoft data center delays are raising questions about its financing viability.

cards.title: Reuters Reports Third Huang Affair Allegation
cards.body: A second unnamed Nvidia employee was allegedly involved in a third affair with Huang. Reuters is withholding the employee's identity pending further investigation.

cards.title: Google Search Upgrade Powered by Gemini
cards.body: Google's new AI Mode, powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, better understands complex queries and delivers richer visual responses. The upgrade promises improved search relevance and comprehension.

cards.title: Nectar Automates Influencer Discovery and Outreach
cards.body: Nectar's new AI agent automates creator discovery, partnership management, and campaign tracking for brands. The platform streamlines influencer marketing workflows at scale.

cards.title: Huang Exit Threatens Nvidia Open Source Commitment
cards.body: Questions arise about Nvidia's continued support for open source AI following Huang's resignation. The company's Hugging Face acquisition and open-weight model advocacy are now uncertain.

cards.title: Hugging Face Pledges Continued Open Source Fight
cards.body: Hugging Face CEO vowed ongoing commitment to open source AI despite Huang's departure. The pledge addresses concerns about Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition intentions.

cards.title: United Airlines Blocks AI Agents from Booking
cards.body: United Airlines has prohibited customers from using AI agents to book flights and manage reservations. The airline cited cybersecurity risks as the primary concern.

cards.title: SoftBank's $3B AI Power Loss Signals Market Reality
cards.body: SoftBank lost over $3 billion preordering natural gas turbines for AI data centers. The loss may cap ambitious AI infrastructure power expansion plans.

cards.title: Silicon Valley's AI Leaders Miss Election Predictions
cards.body: Tech visionaries like OpenAI's Sam Altman and Elon Musk claim to predict the future, yet dramatically miscalled the midterms. The gap between their long-term vision and actual foresight raises questions about AI's predictive capabilities.

cards.title: Nvidia Confirms Chip-Tracking Technology Feasibility
cards.body: Nvidia privately told lawmakers it could technically implement anti-smuggling measures for chip tracking, contradicting public industry skepticism. The confirmation suggests AI-assisted chip security is more viable than previously claimed.

cards.title: Brain Implants Decode Activity for Computer Control
cards.body: Scientists have developed brain implants that decode neural activity to control robotic limbs and enable communication. Volunteers in these trials are crucial to advancing AI-assisted brain-computer interfaces.

cards.title: FAA Deploys AI for Air Traffic Management
cards.body: The FAA is expanding AI-powered systems nationwide to manage air traffic congestion across entire U.S. airspace. This marks a significant shift toward automated aviation coordination.

cards.title: OpenAI Board Member Warns of AI Takeover
cards.body: An OpenAI board member expressed concern that an AI "takeover" of society could occur within months. The warning reflects growing internal anxiety about rapid AI advancement and deployment.

cards.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen Model
cards.body: Google has launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, finally replacing the 3.8 Flash version in its AI lineup. The upgrade represents the next generation in Google's language model evolution.
